STRIKE.name: Strike
STRIKE.text: Damage equal to the dice it reads.

CLEAVE.name: Cleave
CLEAVE.text: Damage twice the pair's value. Deals half damage to adjacent enemies.

flawless.text: Adjacent enemies take the full damage.

CRUSH.name: Crush
CRUSH.text: Damage five times the matched value.

BARRAGE.name: Barrage
BARRAGE.text: Deal {hit} damage for every die in the straight.

OVERKILL.name: Overkill
OVERKILL.text: Damage equal to your total dice roll.

flawless.text: On a kill, repeat against another enemy.

SPALL.name: Spall
SPALL.text: Damage twice the sum of your two lowest dice.

flawless.text: Each low die also leaves a poison.

FURY.name: Fury
FURY.text: 3 damage for every die you rerolled this turn.

flawless.text: Increase damage by your missing HP percentage.

DETONATE.name: Detonate
DETONATE.text: Consume all target Poison. Deal 4 damage per stack consumed.

flawless.text: Apply half the consumed Poison to adjacent enemies.

APEX.name: Apex
APEX.text: Deal damage equal to your highest qualifying roll.

flawless.text: Double damage if that roll is a crown: its die's own top face.

CREST.name: Crest
CREST.text: Damage {mult} times the total of your crowns.

flawless.text: Each crown also pays its value in Pyrite.

GRUDGE.name: Grudge
GRUDGE.text: Deal damage worth {share}% of your missing health.

flawless.text: Heal a quarter of the damage dealt.

HONE.name: Hone
HONE.text: Deal 4 damage, plus 1 for every time it has fired this run.

FLURRY.name: Flurry
FLURRY.text: Deal 2 damage, once for every point of the pair's value.

TEMPER.name: Temper
TEMPER.text: Gain 1 Strength: every hit you deal does 1 more for the rest of the fight.

BLOODLETTING.name: Bloodletting
BLOODLETTING.text: Lose 3 HP. The next gem is amplified by {amp}%.

CRESCENDO.name: Crescendo
CRESCENDO.text: Deal damage equal to {share}% of the Resonance your rail has built this fight.

flawless.text: Gain Charged equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

GUARD.name: Guard
GUARD.text: Block equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Every ally also gains half as much Block.

BULWARK.name: Bulwark
BULWARK.text: Gain Block equal to your total dice roll.

flawless.text: Also gain Retain equal to half that value.

AEGIS.name: Aegis
AEGIS.text: Block to every ally worth {share}% of the top of the straight.

BASTION.name: Bastion
BASTION.text: Block to every ally equal to your total dice roll.

ANCHOR.name: Anchor
ANCHOR.text: 2 block for every die you did not reroll.

RIPOSTE.name: Riposte
RIPOSTE.text: Damage worth {share}% of the block you lost since your last turn.

flawless.text: Gain Block equal to 25% of the damage dealt.

SHELTER.name: Shelter
SHELTER.text: Give the weakest ally Block equal to twice the pair's value.

MORTAR.name: Mortar
MORTAR.text: Gain Retain equal to {share}% of your current Block.

CALTROP.name: Caltrop
CALTROP.text: Gain 1 Spikes for every odd die.

flawless.text: Then gain Block equal to your Spikes.

BEZEL.name: Bezel
BEZEL.text: Gain Block equal to both pair values. Every ally gains 1 Ward.

HARDENING.name: Hardening
HARDENING.text: Gain 4 Block, plus 1 for every time it has fired this run.

BASH.name: Bash
BASH.text: Deal damage equal to half your Block.

FORTIFY.name: Fortify
FORTIFY.text: Gain Block equal to half your Block.

CHAINMAIL.name: Chainmail
CHAINMAIL.text: For the rest of this turn, every gem that fires after it gives you 2 Block.

flawless.text: Each of those gems also gives you 1 Spikes.

REBOUND.name: Rebound
REBOUND.text: For the rest of this turn, each time you gain Block, deal 3 damage to the target.

MEND.name: Mend
MEND.text: Heal equal to your lowest die roll.

GRAFT.name: Graft
GRAFT.text: Heal equal to both pair values.

BLOOM.name: Bloom
BLOOM.text: Heal every ally 1 for each odd die.

flawless.text: Give each ally 1 Charged per odd die.

RENEWAL.name: Renewal
RENEWAL.text: Heal the top of the straight and Cleanse {cleanse#stack}.

LIFELINE.name: Lifeline
LIFELINE.text: Give each ally Lifeline equal to the matched value.

flawless.text: Lifeline also restores that much Block.

SAP.name: Sap
SAP.text: Damage worth {share}% of the healing you did this turn.

flawless.text: The party also heals for half of it.

SIPHON.name: Siphon
SIPHON.text: Heal the weakest ally for {share}% of all enemy Poison.

flawless.text: Gain 1 more Regeneration for every die you kept.

WELLSPRING.name: Wellspring
WELLSPRING.text: Heal half your dice total. Healing past full health becomes Block.

flawless.text: Heal your whole dice total instead.

THIRST.name: Thirst
THIRST.text: Heal {share}% of the damage you have dealt this turn.

flawless.text: Healing past full health is dealt as damage to the target.

HEARTWOOD.name: Heartwood
HEARTWOOD.text: Gain 3 max HP for the rest of the run, and heal 3.

flawless.text: Then deal damage equal to 10% of your max HP.

VENOM.name: Venom
VENOM.text: Poison equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Also deals half that value as damage.

MIASMA.name: Miasma
MIASMA.text: Apply 1 Poison to every enemy for each even die it reads.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.text: Apply 1 Curse per rolled 1. Reduce enemy max HP by {loss} per rolled 1.

flawless.text: Deal damage equal to the target's Curse stacks.

SHATTER.name: Shatter
SHATTER.text: Remove Block equal to three times the matched value. Deal damage equal to the Block removed.

PETRIFY.name: Petrify
PETRIFY.text: Deal damage equal to the four matched dice, and stun the target.

CONFLUENCE.name: Confluence
CONFLUENCE.text: Move every enemy's Poison onto the target. Its Poison ticks once.

HEMLOCK.name: Hemlock
HEMLOCK.text: Gain Poison equal to your highest die. Then every enemy gains {gift}% of your Poison.

ARSENIC.name: Arsenic
ARSENIC.text: For the rest of the fight, every hit that gets past Block also applies 1 Poison.

CONTAGION.name: Contagion
CONTAGION.text: For the rest of this turn, every gem that fires after it applies 1 Poison to the target.

TITHE.name: Tithe
TITHE.text: Pyrite equal to the pair's value.

flawless.text: Deal damage equal to the Pyrite gained.

JACKPOT.name: Jackpot
JACKPOT.text: Gain Pyrite equal to the matched value × matched dice count.

LUCKY_SEVEN.name: Lucky Seven
LUCKY_SEVEN.text: Deal 7 damage and gain {pay} Pyrite per rolled 7.

flawless.text: With at least three 7s, receive the reward 7 times.

WAGER.name: Wager
WAGER.text: Spend {cost} Pyrite to deal your highest roll as damage. On a kill, gain twice the Pyrite spent.

flawless.text: On a kill, gain three times the Pyrite spent.

DOUBLE_DOWN.name: Double Down
DOUBLE_DOWN.text: Flip a coin: {odds}% the next gem is doubled, else it does nothing.

STAKE.name: Stake
STAKE.text: Spend {cost} Pyrite. Amplify the next gem by {amp}%.

APPRAISE.name: Appraise
APPRAISE.text: Appraise 1 raw stone in your bag. Deal damage equal to its value.

flawless.text: Appraise up to 2 stones and deal their combined value.

GILDED_ARMOR.name: Gilded Armor
GILDED_ARMOR.text: Gain Block equal to {share}% of your Pyrite.

TAILINGS.name: Tailings
TAILINGS.text: Gain {pay} Pyrite for each gem that fizzled earlier this turn. Each fizzle pays once.

flawless.text: Gain 1 more Pyrite per paid fizzle.

PLACER.name: Placer
PLACER.text: Each creature that has died this turn has a {chance}% chance to drop a raw stone.

flawless.text: Its stones are rolled with an elite's luck.

DIVIDEND.name: Dividend
DIVIDEND.text: Gain 1 Pyrite for every 10 you carry, up to 10.

GILDING.name: Gilding
GILDING.text: Gild the face your highest die shows for the rest of the run: it pays Pyrite whenever it's rolled.

flawless.text: Also gild the face your lowest die shows.
Throw it twice and keep the higher.

GLIMMER.name: Glimmer
GLIMMER.text: Permanently raise the face of the first matched die by 1.

flawless.text: Raise every face of the first matched die.

REFRACT.name: Refract
REFRACT.text: Roll a phantom copy of your largest die.

POLISH.name: Polish
POLISH.text: Adjacent gems gain 1 Clarity this fight.

MIRROR.name: Mirror
MIRROR.text: Reflect half of the next enemy attack.

FACET.name: Facet
FACET.text: Adjacent gems gain 1 Cut this fight.

ENRICH.name: Enrich
ENRICH.text: Adjacent gems gain 1 Carat this fight.

SEDIMENT.name: Sediment
SEDIMENT.text: Add a phantom die copying your lowest roll.

OVERTURN.name: Overturn
OVERTURN.text: Turn your lowest die over. The face underneath is the other parity.

flawless.text: Turn over your two lowest dice.

LODESTONE.name: Lodestone
LODESTONE.text: Store {share}% of your Resonance as Charged.

BIRTHRIGHT.name: Birthright
BIRTHRIGHT.text: Your Birthstone fires now as well, at {share}% of the Resonance so far.

TUMBLE.name: Tumble
TUMBLE.text: Roll a phantom d6 into your hand.

SPECTRUM.name: Spectrum
SPECTRUM.text: For each color that has fired this turn: Red, 3 damage; Blue, 3 Block; Green, heal 3; Violet, 2 Poison; Gold, 2 Pyrite; White, 1 Resonance.

flawless.text: Count every gem that fired, not just every color.

INVERT.name: Invert
INVERT.text: Repeat the gem before it at {share}%, inverted.

SEAM_RED.name: Red Seam
SEAM_RED.text: Every Red gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_BLUE.name: Blue Seam
SEAM_BLUE.text: Every Blue gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_GREEN.name: Green Seam
SEAM_GREEN.text: Every Green gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_VIOLET.name: Violet Seam
SEAM_VIOLET.text: Every Violet gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_GOLD.name: Gold Seam
SEAM_GOLD.text: Every Gold gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

SEAM_WHITE.name: White Seam
SEAM_WHITE.text: Every White gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

FIRE_OPAL.name: Fire Opal
FIRE_OPAL.text: Your other gems gain {heat#carat} for the rest of the fight.

flawless.text: And a Cut step with it.

DOUBLET.name: Doublet
DOUBLET.text: Copies the skill of the previous gem, opals included.

flawless.text: Also copies that gem's Flawless effect.

MATRIX.name: Matrix
MATRIX.text: Activate the first two gems before it that fizzled this turn.

flawless.text: Activate every gem before it that fizzled.

ECHO.name: Echo
ECHO.text: Create a Void copy of the last gem that fired, never another Echo. It lasts for the rest of the fight.

PINFIRE.name: Pinfire
PINFIRE.text: Adds {share}% of the Resonance so far.

flawless.text: Every gem after it adds double Resonance this turn.

CONTRA_LUZ.name: Contra Luz
CONTRA_LUZ.text: Roll a phantom d6. Your phantom dice stay into next turn.

HYDROPHANE.name: Hydrophane
HYDROPHANE.text: Your smallest die gains a drop. At 3 drops it grows a size for the rest of the run.

flawless.text: Your smallest die shrinks a size instead, down to a d2.

RAINBOW_SEAM.name: Rainbow Seam
RAINBOW_SEAM.text: Every gem before it that has already fired this turn fires again.

flawless.text: Each of them plays a second time.

PROCESSION.name: Procession
PROCESSION.text: By the top of the straight: deal {dmg}% as damage, gain {blk}% as Block, heal {mend}%, apply {psn}% as Poison and gain {pay}% as Pyrite.

flawless.text: Effects apply to every enemy and every ally.

BLACK_OPAL.name: Black Opal
BLACK_OPAL.text: At the start of each fight it absorbs a random gem from your bag, destroying it, and keeps its skill for the rest of the run. When it fires, every skill it has absorbed fires too.

flawless.text: It absorbs two gems at the start of each fight.

QUINTESSENCE.name: Quintessence
QUINTESSENCE.text: Deal 5 damage, gain 5 Block, heal 5 and gain 5 Pyrite. Then this gem gains 5 carats for the rest of the fight.

flawless.text: Your other gems gain 5 carats too.

GEMINI.name: Gemini
GEMINI.text: For each pair in your hand, the gems on either side of it fire.

CERTAINTY.name: Certainty
CERTAINTY.text: Every gem after it fires this turn, whatever the dice show.

flawless.text: Every gem after it fires twice.

NEEDLE.name: Needle
NEEDLE.text: +1 damage for every die this gem reads.

EMBERLINE.name: Emberline
EMBERLINE.text: 1 poison to the target when this fires.

GLINT.name: Glint
GLINT.text: Pyrite equal to the dice matched when this fires.

DUSTING.name: Dusting
DUSTING.text: Block equal to the dice matched when this fires.

VEIL.name: Veil
VEIL.text: This gem reads your lowest die as if it were your highest.

CATS_EYE.name: Cat's Eye
CATS_EYE.text: This gem reads every 1 as wild.

GRAINING.name: Graining
GRAINING.text: This gem counts held dice twice in sets.

ZONING_RED.name: Red Zoning
ZONING_RED.text: Counts as Red as well as its own color.

ZONING_BLUE.name: Blue Zoning
ZONING_BLUE.text: Counts as Blue as well as its own color.

ZONING_GREEN.name: Green Zoning
ZONING_GREEN.text: Counts as Green as well as its own color.

ZONING_VIOLET.name: Violet Zoning
ZONING_VIOLET.text: Counts as Violet as well as its own color.

ZONING_GOLD.name: Gold Zoning
ZONING_GOLD.text: Counts as Gold as well as its own color.

ZONING_WHITE.name: White Zoning
ZONING_WHITE.text: Counts as White as well as its own color.

FEATHER.name: Feather
FEATHER.text: The next gem in the rail is judged one Cut step better.

TWINNING_WISP.name: Twinning Wisp
TWINNING_WISP.text: Fires again if the gem before it fired.

FINGERPRINT.name: Fingerprint
FINGERPRINT.text: Carries one inclusion of the gem before it.

HALO.name: Halo
HALO.text: Neighbouring gems of this color gain a carat.

FRACTURE.name: Fracture
FRACTURE.text: Twice the strength, but it fizzles if any die shows a 1.

BRUISE.name: Bruise
BRUISE.text: Half again the strength; you lose 2 HP when it fires.

KNOT.name: Knot
KNOT.text: +2 carats, but it cannot leave its socket during a run.

VOID.name: Void
VOID.text: Takes no socket: it rides one beside whatever is set there and fires right after it. Fragile: cannot be sold or kept in the vault; shatters when the run ends, or when revealed at home.

CAVITY.name: Cavity
CAVITY.text: Its carats count double, but its cut counts as Poor.

FLUORESCENCE.name: Fluorescence
FLUORESCENCE.text: +1 carat for every depth below 10 while underground.

ALEXANDRITE.name: Alexandrite
ALEXANDRITE.text: Takes the color of whatever socket it sits in.

EVEN.name: Even
EVEN.text: Every face an even number, each one showing twice.

ODD.name: Odd
ODD.text: Every face an odd number, each one showing twice.

SPLIT.name: Split
SPLIT.text: The middle numbers are removed, leaving only the highest and lowest, repeated. Bigger dice repeat them more.

GAMBLERS.name: Gambler's
GAMBLERS.text: Every 6 and every 8 comes up a 7.

PAIRED.name: Paired
PAIRED.text: Half as many numbers, each appearing twice. Which numbers are picked when the die is cut.

STRETCHED.name: Stretched
STRETCHED.text: Every face doubled, so the die tops out at twice its size.

SHALLOW.name: Shallow
SHALLOW.text: All numbers are squeezed into the bottom half. It still counts as its full size, so every face is low.

WILD.name: Wild
WILD.text: Counts as any value, and as the die top for totals.

EXPLODING.name: Exploding
EXPLODING.text: Rolls again and adds, up to three times over.

SHINY.name: Shiny
SHINY.text: One Resonance more for every gem it helps light.

GOLDEN.name: Golden
GOLDEN.text: Pays 2 pyrite every time it is rolled.

TALLY.name: Tally
TALLY.text: Goes up by 1 permanently each time it's rolled.

STICKY.name: Sticky
STICKY.text: Carries into the next turn instead of being thrown again.

TWIN.name: Twin
TWIN.text: Counts as two dice in every set.

DOUBLED.name: Doubled
DOUBLED.text: Counts as double its number everywhere.

LOCKED.name: Locked
LOCKED.text: Once it shows, the die cannot be thrown again this fight.

BLANK.name: Blank
BLANK.text: Has no value and doesn't count toward any pattern.

RUBY.name: Ruby
RUBY.text: Half again as strong on every red gem it helps light.

SAPPHIRE.name: Sapphire
SAPPHIRE.text: Half again as strong on every blue gem it helps light.

EMERALD.name: Emerald
EMERALD.text: Half again as strong on every green gem it helps light.

AMETHYST.name: Amethyst
AMETHYST.text: Half again as strong on every violet gem it helps light.

CITRINE.name: Citrine
CITRINE.text: Half again as strong on every gold gem it helps light.

DIAMOND.name: Diamond
DIAMOND.text: Half again as strong on every white gem it helps light.

OPAL.name: Opal
OPAL.text: Half again as strong on every gem it helps light, whatever color it is.

GLASS.name: Glass
GLASS.text: Half again as strong on every gem it helps light. Each throw has a 10% chance to break it.

CRYSTAL.name: Crystal
CRYSTAL.text: +1 Resonance every time it's thrown, rerolls included.

IRON.name: Iron
IRON.text: Rolls twice and keeps the higher result.

CLOUD.name: Cloud
CLOUD.text: Rolls twice and keeps the lower result.

FOOLS_GOLD.name: Fool's Gold
FOOLS_GOLD.text: Pays 2 pyrite every time it is thrown.

GRANITE.name: Granite
GRANITE.text: Creatures can't break, blank or shrink it.

BLOOD.name: Blood
BLOOD.text: Rerolling it costs 2 HP. Its face goes up by 1 every time something dies.

ARDOR.name: Ardor
ARDOR.title: the Knight
ARDOR.text: The tank. Locks in early, heals for unused rerolls, and hits hard with three of a kind.

passive.name: Second Wind
passive.text: Heal Resonance for each unused reroll when your rail closes.

birthstone.name: Rally
birthstone.text: Almandine garnet in a shield cut. Sets of matching dice rally the Knight.
birthstone.face: Jaw set, eyes narrowed, a slow nod.

tiers.name: Rank
tiers.text: A pair: gain Resonance block.

tiers.name: File
tiers.text: Three of a kind: deal three times Resonance.

tiers.name: Phalanx
tiers.text: Four of a kind: cleanse yourself and stun the target.

tiers.name: Legion
tiers.text: Five of a kind: deal five times Resonance, five times.

VESPER.name: Vesper
VESPER.title: the Rogue
VESPER.text: The assassin. Four d4s and a d12, betting on one big roll.

passive.name: Riposte
passive.text: Gain Resonance block for every hit one of your gems lands.

birthstone.name: Thousand Cuts
birthstone.text: Black opal in a thin marquise cut, dark with tiny flecks of color.
birthstone.face: A thin smile, eyes on the target.

tiers.name: Thousand Cuts
tiers.text: Five different values: deal Resonance once for every point on your highest die.

tiers.name: Clean Kill
tiers.text: A crown on your highest die as well: every cut lands twice.

CADENCE.name: Cadence
CADENCE.title: the Wizard
CADENCE.text: The combo player. Builds straights and can make a whole turn fire twice.

birthstone.name: Encore
birthstone.text: Ametrine in a step cut, fading from violet to gold.
birthstone.face: Eyes closed, one hand raised like a conductor.

tiers.name: Motif
tiers.text: Three in a row: the last gem that fired plays again.

tiers.name: Overture
tiers.text: A straight of four: deal four times Resonance to every creature.

tiers.name: Encore
tiers.text: A straight of five: every gem that fired plays again, Overture included, and Resonance keeps climbing.

RUE.name: Rue
RUE.title: the Apothecary
RUE.text: The low roller. Wants 1s and low dice, and heals off poison.

passive.name: Leech
passive.text: Heal Resonance whenever poison damages a creature.

birthstone.name: Bitter Draught
birthstone.text: Dark tourmaline in a teardrop briolette cut, murky green-black with a bubble inside.
birthstone.face: A wry grimace, as if tasting it.

tiers.name: Tincture
tiers.text: Four or more low dice: poison the target for Resonance.

tiers.name: Draught
tiers.text: All five low: every poison on every creature ticks at once.

tiers.name: Dregs
tiers.text: All five showing 1: every poison ticks Resonance times.

PUCK.name: Puck
PUCK.title: the Harlequin
PUCK.text: The trickster. Flips dice between odd and even to line up the hand.

passive.name: Sleight
passive.text: Once a turn, turn one die over. The face underneath is the other parity.

birthstone.name: Motley
birthstone.text: Watermelon tourmaline, pink one half and green the other, in a checkerboard cut. The Changing Face: a face different from last turn's pays double, and every turn the faces keep changing pays one more.
birthstone.face: One eye winking, mouth half grin, half frown.

tiers.name: The Cruel Face
tiers.text: All five dice odd: deal three times Resonance.

tiers.name: The Kind Face
tiers.text: All five dice even: gain three times Resonance block.

tiers.name: Full Motley
tiers.text: All one parity and all different, like 2-4-6-8-10: both faces, doubled, and the target is stunned.

FLORIN.name: Florin
FLORIN.title: the Gambler
FLORIN.text: The high roller. Seven sockets, and every roll is all or nothing.

passive.name: All or Nothing
passive.text: Florin must throw all dice together, but gains +1 Resonance for every crown rolled.

birthstone.name: High Roller
birthstone.text: Pyrite in a lopsided seven-sided cut, flecked with fool's gold.

tiers.name: Lucky
tiers.text: Deal Resonance for each crown showing.

tiers.name: Heating Up
tiers.text: Gain +1 reroll next turn.

tiers.name: Hot Streak
tiers.text: Gain a phantom Gambler's die next turn.

tiers.name: On Fire
tiers.text: Gain double Resonance next turn.

tiers.name: Jackpot
tiers.text: Deal 7× Resonance seven times. Gain 7× Resonance pyrite.

tiers.name: Bust
tiers.text: Take Resonance damage and lose Resonance pyrite.

RAW_STONE.name: A Read Stone
RAW_STONE.text: An appraised stone from depth 4, ready to set.

PICK_STONE.name: Pick of Three
PICK_STONE.text: Choose one of three raw stones from depth 4, each a different color. It's appraised right away and can go straight onto your rail if its skill isn't there already.

SOFT_ROCK.name: Soft Rock
SOFT_ROCK.text: The creatures in your first three fights arrive at half health.

HAMMERED.name: Hammered
HAMMERED.text: A random die is one size bigger for this run.

STEADY_HANDS.name: Steady Hands
STEADY_HANDS.text: +1 reroll every turn until the first landing.

COST_WOUND.name: A Bad Fall
COST_WOUND.text: You lose 30% of your health before you start.

COST_CHIPPED.name: Chipped
COST_CHIPPED.text: A random stone on your rail is one Cut step worse for this run.

REWARD_CARATS.name: Four Carats
REWARD_CARATS.text: A random stone on your rail gains 4 carats for this run.

REWARD_WILD.name: A Wild Face
REWARD_WILD.text: A random die has its highest face turned wild for this run.

FRAGILE_STONE.name: A Fragile Find
FRAGILE_STONE.text: A heavy, appraised stone from deeper in the mine. It shatters when the run ends and can't be taken home.

STAKE_CARAT.name: Weighed Heavier
STAKE_CARAT.text: A random stone on your rail gains 2 carats for this run.

STAKE_CUT.name: A Truer Set
STAKE_CUT.text: A random stone on your rail is one Cut step better for this run.

REWARD_ALL.name: The Whole Rail
REWARD_ALL.text: Every stone set on your rail gains a carat, a Cut step and a Clarity step for this run.

LANTERN_MOTH.name: Lantern Moth
LANTERN_MOTH.text: A moth with a lantern for a body. Its light gives you a free reroll; Singe burns you for every reroll you used.
LANTERN_MOTH.tip: Its rerolls are free, but Singe charges for every one you used.

moves.name: Lantern
moves.text: One more reroll on your next turn

moves.name: Singe
moves.text: {0} damage for every reroll you used this turn

RAIL_RAT.name: Rail Rat
RAIL_RAT.text: A rat that runs the old rails in packs. One face in four calls another rat.
RAIL_RAT.tip: Kill them before the pack grows.

moves.name: Scurry
moves.text: A Rail Rat joins the fight

CAVE_TICK.name: Cave Tick
CAVE_TICK.text: A crystal-backed tick. Its Latch takes one of your dice until after your next turn.
CAVE_TICK.tip: Kill it before it latches on, or you lose a die next turn.

moves.name: Latch
moves.text: Takes a die; it comes back after your next turn

MAGPIE.name: Magpie
MAGPIE.text: A magpie that snatches pyrite from the richest player. Every Snatch it lands turns into Flee, and when Flee lands it leaves with everything it took.
MAGPIE.tip: Kill it before it flees, or your pyrite goes with it.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.text: Takes {0} pyrite from the richest player. Then this face becomes Flee: the next time it lands, the magpie leaves with everything it took

moves.name: Flee
moves.text: Leaves the fight with everything it took

SILT_SLIME.name: Silt Slime
SILT_SLIME.text: A mound of silt wearing a lost miner's helmet. It oozes and engulfs you in poison, and splits in two when struck hard.
SILT_SLIME.tip: Hit it hard and it splits; finish the halves.

CLOUDER.name: Clouder
CLOUDER.text: A heap of stony fog. Its Fog clouds a socket on your rail until someone hits it; Gather gives it a thick wall of block.
CLOUDER.tip: Hit it to lift the fog off your rail.

moves.name: Fog
moves.text: Clouds a socket on your rail: the gem there does nothing until you hit the Clouder

PIT_MOLE.name: Pit Mole
PIT_MOLE.text: A mole with crystal claws. When it digs in it cannot be targeted, and it comes up with Erupt at its next action.
PIT_MOLE.tip: When it digs in, brace for Erupt.

moves.name: Dig In
moves.text: Burrows: cannot be targeted until its next action, when it comes up with Erupt

VEIN_WRAITH.name: Vein Wraith
VEIN_WRAITH.text: A wraith of the ore veins. Its Wail goes through block, and it Fades out of reach.
VEIN_WRAITH.tip: Block does not stop its Wail.

moves.name: Fade
moves.text: Cannot be targeted until its next action

QUARTZ_GOLEM.name: Quartz Golem
QUARTZ_GOLEM.text: A golem of stacked quartz. It fortifies behind block it keeps, and now and then throws a storm of shards.
QUARTZ_GOLEM.tip: Its block stays: break it down or wait it out.

moves.name: Fortify
moves.text: {0} block, kept into its next turn

moves.name: Shardstorm
moves.text: 3 hits of {0} damage: a storm of quartz shards

GLASS_WYRM.name: Glass Wyrm
GLASS_WYRM.text: A wyrm of glass coiled on the floor. It sharpens itself, breathes three hits of shattered glass, and holds up a mirror that sends half of every blow back at whoever threw it.
GLASS_WYRM.tip: Hold your big hits while its mirror is up.

moves.name: Sharpen
moves.text: +{0} Strength for the fight: its glass edges keener

moves.name: Mirror
moves.text: Until its next action, half of every blow on it goes back to whoever threw it

THE_FOREMAN.name: The Foreman
THE_FOREMAN.text: Warden of the Quarry: a rock-crab in a miner's hard hat. Its pick die hits; its lamp die shores up, buries your sockets in rubble for the fight, takes a die, and reinforces a pick face into a triple Blast.
THE_FOREMAN.tip: The longer it lives, the more of your rail is buried.

moves.name: Bury
moves.text: Buries a socket on your rail in rubble for the fight

moves.name: Reinforce
moves.text: One of its Pick faces becomes Blast

THE_REGENT.name: The Mirror Regent
THE_REGENT.text: Warden of the Quarry: a queen of cut glass. Hit it hard and its Reflection throws the damage back; its Mirror sends half of every blow back at the thrower; Mirror Image throws your best die back at you.
THE_REGENT.tip: Every blow you land comes back when its Reflection lands.

moves.name: Reflection
moves.text: Throws back the damage it took since its last action

moves.name: Mirror
moves.text: Until its next action, half of every blow on it goes back to whoever threw it

moves.name: Mirror Image
moves.text: Throws your best die back at you: damage equal to the highest face any player shows

THE_DRILL.name: The Drill
THE_DRILL.text: The Quarry's final boss: a drilling machine of iron drums. Its treads roll your dice for you, grind your gems dull, rev an Overdrive onto its drill and call rail rats; its drill bores.
THE_DRILL.tip: Each Rev puts another Overdrive on its drill.

moves.name: Roller
moves.text: Rolls your dice for you: no rerolls on your next turn

moves.name: Grind
moves.text: {0} Dulled: your gems lose a Cut step

moves.name: Rev
moves.text: One of its Bore faces becomes Overdrive

LAMPREY_KNOT.name: Lamprey Knot
LAMPREY_KNOT.text: Three lampreys braided into one: three small dice, many small bites, and now and then a drink that heals it.
LAMPREY_KNOT.tip: Many small bites: block soaks them well.

CAVE_CRAYFISH.name: Cave Crayfish
CAVE_CRAYFISH.text: A pale crayfish that grips your best die in its claw. The die sits out every throw until the crayfish is hurt.
CAVE_CRAYFISH.tip: Hit it to make it let go of your die.

moves.name: Grip
moves.text: Holds your best die in its claws: it sits out every throw until the crayfish loses health

DROWNED_MINER.name: Drowned Miner
DROWNED_MINER.text: A heap of drowned gear held together by seep water. It pulls your dice down a size for a turn, and the first time it dies it gets back up at half health.
DROWNED_MINER.tip: It gets up once. Save something for the second time.

moves.name: Pull Under
moves.text: Your dice shrink a size; they grow back after your next turn

SEEP_EEL.name: Seep Eel
SEEP_EEL.text: A lightning eel. Shock locks your highest die for a turn, and Arc runs three small hits down the line.
SEEP_EEL.tip: A locked die cannot be rerolled next turn.

moves.name: Shock
moves.text: Locks your highest die: it shows the same face and cannot be rerolled on your next turn

moves.name: Arc
moves.text: 3 hits of {0} damage: lightning down the line

THE_LOCKKEEPER.name: The Lock-Keeper
THE_LOCKKEEPER.text: Warden of the Seeps: a sluice-snail with a valve wheel. Its wheel die locks your best die in the gate and turns the wheel, which etches another Sluice onto its gate die; Flood is its worst.
THE_LOCKKEEPER.tip: Every Turn of the Wheel puts another Sluice on its gate.

moves.name: Turn the Wheel
moves.text: One Wrench face on the gate die becomes Sluice

moves.name: Lock
moves.text: Locks your highest die in the gate: it sits out every throw until you hit the Lock-Keeper

moves.name: Dam
moves.text: {0} block, and anything that hits it is hit back for {1}

moves.name: Flood
moves.text: {0} damage, and the water washes the cut off your gems: {1} Dulled

THE_DROWNED_CHOIR.name: The Drowned Choir
THE_DROWNED_CHOIR.text: Warden of the Seeps: drowned heads singing out of a dark pool, a die each. Another Voice raises a new head, five at most; all three heads on Requiem is a chorus through block.
THE_DROWNED_CHOIR.tip: Kill it before the fifth voice joins.

moves.name: Another Voice
moves.text: A new head rises from the water: +1 d6, five at most

moves.name: Requiem Chorus
moves.text: All three heads on Requiem: another {0} damage through block

THE_UNDERTOW.name: The Undertow
THE_UNDERTOW.text: The Seeps' final boss: a serpent of cut boulders. Its jaws bite and drag the whole party under; its tail thrashes, dives and surfaces hard, and calls seep eels.
THE_UNDERTOW.tip: Drag Under stuns the whole party at once.

moves.name: Drag Under
moves.text: Drags you under: Stunned for a turn

moves.name: Dive
moves.text: Dives: cannot be targeted until its next action, when it surfaces

WILL_O_WISP.name: Will-o'-Wisp
WILL_O_WISP.text: A pink cousin of the Lantern Moth. Its light gives you a free reroll; its Lure marks you once for every reroll you used.
WILL_O_WISP.tip: Every reroll you take is a Mark it can cash in.

moves.name: Lantern
moves.text: One more reroll on your next turn

moves.name: Lure
moves.text: {0} Marked for every reroll you used this turn

ECHO_SPRITE.name: Echo Sprite
ECHO_SPRITE.text: A small glass fairy. Half its faces are a mirror: the next blow on it hits whoever threw it.
ECHO_SPRITE.tip: Hit it with something small first, while its mirror is up.

moves.name: Mirror
moves.text: The next blow on it hits whoever threw it instead

GLINT_MAGPIE.name: Glint Magpie
GLINT_MAGPIE.text: A silver magpie. It snatches pyrite and flees like any magpie, and its glare dulls your gems.
GLINT_MAGPIE.tip: Kill it before it flees with your pyrite.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.text: Takes {0} pyrite from the richest player; then this face becomes Flee

moves.name: Dazzle
moves.text: {0} Dulled: your gems lose a Cut step

moves.name: Flee
moves.text: Leaves the fight with everything it took

PRISM_GOLEM.name: Prism Golem
PRISM_GOLEM.text: A golem of violet glass. Where the Quartz Golem fortifies, it refracts: half of every blow on it goes back at the party.
PRISM_GOLEM.tip: Hold your big hits while it refracts.

moves.name: Refract
moves.text: Until its next action, half of every blow on it goes back to the party

REFRACTOR.name: Refractor
REFRACTOR.text: A crystal lens that splits light into many small hits, sharpens itself, and refracts blows back at the party.
REFRACTOR.tip: It grows stronger every time it sharpens. Kill it early.

moves.name: Refract
moves.text: Until its next action, half of every blow on it goes back to the party

SHARD_WYRM.name: Shard Wyrm
SHARD_WYRM.text: A pink glass wyrm. Its breath is one great blow through block.

moves.name: Mirror
moves.text: Half of every blow on it goes back until its next action

THE_GLAZIER.name: The Glazier
THE_GLAZIER.text: Warden of the Glass Veins: a glass scorpion with a diamond saw on its tail. Its claws pinch twice and anneal; its saw slices, eviscerates with ten small cuts, and cuts every face your dice show down by one for good.
THE_GLAZIER.tip: Its Cut wears your dice down for good.

moves.name: Anneal
moves.text: {0} block, and anything that hits it is hit back for {1}

moves.name: Skitter
moves.text: Up the wall: cannot be targeted until its next action

moves.name: Slice
moves.text: {0} damage: a quick swipe of the saw

moves.name: Eviscerate
moves.text: 10 hits of {0} damage: the saw spinning into you

moves.name: Cut
moves.text: Every face your dice show loses {0}, for good

THE_KALEIDOSCOPE.name: The Kaleidoscope
THE_KALEIDOSCOPE.text: Warden of the Glass Veins: a great eye of coloured glass, two dice. Drink drinks a colour for a turn and steals what those gems do; both dice on Drink and it drinks the party's favourite too.
THE_KALEIDOSCOPE.tip: The colour it drinks does it no harm, and feeds it.

moves.name: Drink
moves.text: Drinks a colour for one turn

moves.name: Deep Drink
moves.text: Both dice on Drink: it drinks the colour the party fires most, too

THE_PRISMARCH.name: The Prismarch
THE_PRISMARCH.text: The Glass Veins' final boss: a crowned colossus of crystal with prisms floating round it. While a prism floats it takes half damage. Its crown raises prisms, gathers light and grows brighter; its shards crush and lance.
THE_PRISMARCH.tip: Shatter the prisms first. Hold back while it gathers light.

moves.name: Gather Light
moves.text: Takes half damage until its next action, then throws all it was dealt back

PRISM.name: Prism
PRISM.text: A floating prism that shields the Prismarch while it stands.
PRISM.tip: While it floats, the Prismarch takes half damage.

PUFFBALL.name: Puffball
PUFFBALL.text: A round fungus that swells every turn and never attacks. When it dies it bursts, poisoning the party for its swelling.
PUFFBALL.tip: Pop it early: the longer it lives, the worse its burst.

moves.name: Burst
moves.text: When it dies: Poison equal to its swelling

moves.name: Bloat
moves.text: Heals {0}, and its maximum health grows by {1}

SPORE_SLIME.name: Spore Slime
SPORE_SLIME.text: A slime of yellow spores. It splits when struck hard, and every hit on it costs you a Poison.
SPORE_SLIME.tip: Every hit on it poisons you. Use few, heavy hits.

MYCEL_WEAVER.name: Mycel Weaver
MYCEL_WEAVER.text: A stilt-legged fungal spider. Its fangs poison you for what gets past your block, its web takes a die, and Envenom makes your poison bite again.
MYCEL_WEAVER.tip: Block keeps its poison off you.

moves.name: Fangs
moves.text: 2 hits of {0} damage, and Poison for what gets past your block

moves.name: Web
moves.text: Takes a die; it comes back after your next turn

MYCEL_WRAITH.name: Mycel Wraith
MYCEL_WRAITH.text: A green wraith of the Warrens. It drains, wails through block, and regrows, shedding its poison.
MYCEL_WRAITH.tip: Its Regrow sheds the poison you put on it.

moves.name: Fade
moves.text: Cannot be targeted until its next action

CAP_SHAMBLER.name: Cap Shambler
CAP_SHAMBLER.text: A crowd of caps on crawling roots. Its spore cloud halves your healing.
CAP_SHAMBLER.tip: Heal before its spores land, not after.

ROOT_HORROR.name: Root Horror
ROOT_HORROR.text: A walking stump of roots, two dice. It feeds and grows, and thickens its blows.
ROOT_HORROR.tip: It grows every time it feeds. Kill it early.

moves.name: Feed
moves.text: Heals {0}, and its maximum health grows by {1}

THE_GARDENER.name: The Gardener
THE_GARDENER.text: Warden of the Warrens: a crab tilling a garden on its back. Its trowel tends and strengthens every creature, plants puffballs and prunes your dice; its shell rams, sows root horrors and grows thorns.
THE_GARDENER.tip: Kill what it plants, or the garden fights for it.

moves.name: Feed the Soil
moves.text: Every creature gains {0} Strength for the fight

moves.name: Prune
moves.text: Every face your dice show loses {0} for the fight

THE_SPORE_MOTHER.name: The Spore Mother
THE_SPORE_MOTHER.text: Warden of the Warrens: a bloated toad crowded with spore sacs. She poisons, chokes your healing, and makes your poison bite again; Spore and Rot together bite once more.
THE_SPORE_MOTHER.tip: Clear your poison before she makes it bite again.

moves.name: Shed
moves.text: Sheds every affliction on her and heals {1}

moves.name: Bloom
moves.text: Spore and Rot together: your Poison bites once more

THE_HEARTROT.name: The Heartrot
THE_HEARTROT.text: The Warrens' final boss: a rotting heart of gem rooted in the floor, with three tendrils. It rots and festers; a tendril that stands knits it back together.
THE_HEARTROT.tip: Kill the tendrils, or they knit the heart.

CINDER_MOTH.name: Cinder Moth
CINDER_MOTH.text: An orange cousin of the Lantern Moth. Its light gives you a free reroll; its embers burn you for every reroll you used.
CINDER_MOTH.tip: Its rerolls are free, but each one you use burns you.

moves.name: Lantern
moves.text: One more reroll on your next turn

moves.name: Embers
moves.text: {0} Burn for every reroll you used this turn

FIRE_TICK.name: Fire Tick
FIRE_TICK.text: A burning tick. It latches onto your dice and sets you alight.
FIRE_TICK.tip: Kill it before it latches on.

moves.name: Latch
moves.text: Takes a die; it comes back after your next turn

FORGE_IMP.name: Forge Imp
FORGE_IMP.text: A big-headed imp with a hammer. It cackles fire and heat-treats one of your dice a size smaller for the fight.
FORGE_IMP.tip: Its Heat Treat shrinks a die for the whole fight.

moves.name: Heat Treat
moves.text: One of your dice shrinks a size for the fight

SALAMANDER.name: Salamander
SALAMANDER.text: A fire salamander, half claws and half fire.
SALAMANDER.tip: Half its faces burn. Clear Burn when you can.

SLAG_HOUND.name: Slag Hound
SLAG_HOUND.text: A hound of cooling slag. Its maul goes through block, and its howl strengthens every creature for the fight.
SLAG_HOUND.tip: Kill it first: its howl strengthens the whole room.

moves.name: Howl
moves.text: Every creature gains {0} Strength for the fight

EMBER_CRAWLER.name: Ember Crawler
EMBER_CRAWLER.text: A centipede of embers. Its spit melts away your block.
EMBER_CRAWLER.tip: Its spit melts the block you raised.

THE_SMELTER.name: The Smelter
THE_SMELTER.text: Warden of the Furnace: a tortoise whose shell is a volcano. Its crucible pours, scalds and melts a face of your dice blank; its hide armours, tramples and stokes.
THE_SMELTER.tip: Melt blanks a face of your dice for the fight.

moves.name: Melt
moves.text: The face one of your dice shows is blank for the rest of the fight

THE_ANVIL_KNIGHT.name: The Anvil Knight
THE_ANVIL_KNIGHT.text: Warden of the Furnace: an empty suit of armour with fire for a head. Its anvil builds (thorny block it keeps, Strength, tempering Hammers into Smites); its hammer spends it.
THE_ANVIL_KNIGHT.tip: Every Temper turns a Hammer into a Smite. End it quickly.

moves.name: Temper
moves.text: One of its Hammer faces becomes Smite

THE_KILN_WYRM.name: The Kiln Dragon
THE_KILN_WYRM.text: The Furnace's final boss: a red dragon. Its claws rend and pin your dice; its breath burns, dulls, melts a gem and brings down lavafalls; its tail sweeps, quakes your block away and stirs more lava onto its breath.
THE_KILN_WYRM.tip: Each Stir puts more lava on its breath.

moves.name: Cinder
moves.text: {0} Dulled: the heat dulls your gems

moves.name: Melt
moves.text: Melts one of your gems for the rest of the fight

moves.name: Stir
moves.text: A Firebreath face on the breath die becomes Lavafall

GILDED_MAGPIE.name: Gilded Magpie
GILDED_MAGPIE.text: A golden magpie that takes three times as much and is gone just as fast.
GILDED_MAGPIE.tip: Kill it fast: it takes thirty pyrite at a time.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.text: Takes {0} pyrite from the richest player; then this face becomes Flee

moves.name: Flee
moves.text: Leaves the fight with everything it took

CROUPIER_CRAB.name: Croupier Crab
CROUPIER_CRAB.text: A hermit crab living in an iron cauldron. Its die is a casino: two folds that drop pyrite, a jackpot, a double.
CROUPIER_CRAB.tip: Its folds drop pyrite; its jackpot hurts.

moves.name: Rake
moves.text: Takes {0} pyrite from the richest player

GEODE_GOLEM.name: Geode Golem
GEODE_GOLEM.text: A grey golem split open on amethyst. No single hit takes more than a quarter of its health.
GEODE_GOLEM.tip: No hit takes more than a quarter of its health: use many.

HOARD_MIMIC.name: Hoard Mimic
HOARD_MIMIC.text: A treasure chest with teeth. Its Gulp swallows the gem that hit it hardest until it dies, and it drops a raw stone when it does.
HOARD_MIMIC.tip: It swallows the gem that hits it hardest. Kill it to get it back.

moves.name: Gulp
moves.text: Swallows the gem that hit it hardest this turn until it dies

AMETHYST_WYRM.name: Amethyst Wyrm
AMETHYST_WYRM.text: A violet glass wyrm that curses where its kin sharpen.
AMETHYST_WYRM.tip: Its Hex curses the whole party.

moves.name: Mirror
moves.text: Half of every blow on it goes back until its next action

CRYSTAL_HYDRA.name: Crystal Hydra
CRYSTAL_HYDRA.text: A geode grown three crystal heads, a die each. Sprout grows another head, six at most.
CRYSTAL_HYDRA.tip: Every head is another die. Kill it before it sprouts.

moves.name: Sprout
moves.text: Another head: +1 d4, six at most

THE_ASSAYER.name: The Assayer
THE_ASSAYER.text: Warden of the Hollow: a floating obsidian brilliant with a gold eye and a balance. No gem counts for more than 5 carats while it stands. Its scale weighs and balances; its ledger taxes, audits, seizes a die and raises the rate.
THE_ASSAYER.tip: Spend your pyrite before it taxes it.

moves.name: Eat the Rich
moves.text: Heals 1% of its health, and grows by 1%, for every 10 pyrite the richest player holds

moves.name: Tax
moves.text: Takes a tenth of your pyrite, and hits you for what it took

moves.name: Raise the Rate
moves.text: Tax takes a fifth instead of a tenth for the rest of the fight

moves.name: Audit
moves.text: {0} Curse: a bad mark in the book

moves.name: Heavy Tax
moves.text: Takes a fifth of your pyrite, and hits you for what it took

THE_COLLECTOR.name: The Collector
THE_COLLECTOR.text: Warden of the Hollow: a snail whose shell is a cabinet of cases. It acquires your gems and fires them as its own; its cane raps and smashes.
THE_COLLECTOR.tip: It fires the gems it takes. Kill it to get them back.

moves.name: Acquire
moves.text: Takes the finest gem it can fire itself off a rail until it dies

moves.name: Exhibit
moves.text: Fires every gem it holds, as its own

THE_HOLLOW_CROWN.name: The Hollow Crown
THE_HOLLOW_CROWN.text: The Hollow's final boss: a crowned geode giant on one die that grows. Rise adds a Topple and a Summon face, up to a d12; Crowned heals it and doubles its next attack. No single hit takes more than 15% of its health.
THE_HOLLOW_CROWN.tip: Every Rise grows its die. Kill it before it reaches a d12.

moves.name: Rise
moves.text: Its die grows a size, up to a d12, with a Topple face and a Summon face

moves.name: Crowned
moves.text: Heals {0}, and whichever attack lands next is doubled

moves.name: Summon
moves.text: Two Gilded Magpies join the fight

RIFTLING_SWARM.name: Riftling Swarm
RIFTLING_SWARM.text: A swarm of rift shards, two dice that grow to five. Its static makes every gem you fire next turn cost 1 health.

moves.name: Swarm
moves.text: Another riftling: +1 d4, five at most

moves.name: Static
moves.text: Every gem that fires on your next turn costs its owner 1 health

VOID_ECHO.name: Void Echo
VOID_ECHO.text: A ghostly copy of a creature from the first four mines. One face of its first die is Echo Anew, which turns it into another creature at full health.
VOID_ECHO.tip: It is something you have met before, until it becomes something else.

moves.name: Echo
moves.text: {0} damage (an echo throws the dice of the creature it copies)

moves.name: Echo Anew
moves.text: Becomes a different creature from the first four mines, at that creature's full health

ENTROPY_EYE.name: Entropy Eye
ENTROPY_EYE.text: An eye in an opening iris of dark petals. Unmake destroys one of your dice for the rest of the fight.
ENTROPY_EYE.tip: Unmake takes a die for the whole fight.

moves.name: Unmake
moves.text: Destroys one of your dice for the rest of the fight

NULL_SHADE.name: Null Shade
NULL_SHADE.text: A dark crystal hung over turning rings. It sips your health, snuffs a gem for the fight, and dampens your Resonance for a turn.
NULL_SHADE.tip: A dampened turn is a turn to block.

moves.name: Snuff
moves.text: Melts one of your gems for the rest of the fight

moves.name: Dampen
moves.text: Your gems ring for half the Resonance on your next turn

RIFT_SHIFTER.name: Rift Shifter
RIFT_SHIFTER.text: A ribbon of folded stone. It shifts neighbouring gems on your rail for the fight, and folds out of reach.
RIFT_SHIFTER.tip: Check your rail after a Shift: your gems have moved.

moves.name: Shift
moves.text: Two neighbouring gems on each of your rails change places for the fight

moves.name: Fold
moves.text: Cannot be targeted until its next action

COLLAPSAR.name: Collapsar
COLLAPSAR.text: A small collapsing star, two dice. Its gravity pulls every gem aimed at another creature into it; both dice on Collapse is a heavy blow through block.
COLLAPSAR.tip: While its gravity holds, every gem goes into it.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.text: Until its next action, gems aimed at one creature hit it instead

moves.name: Singularity
moves.text: Both dice on Collapse: another {0} damage through block

THE_UNMADE.name: The Infinite Void
THE_UNMADE.text: The Rift's final boss: a black hole with debris swirling into it. It starts with one d12 and grows more; Dread shrinks all your dice for the fight. No single hit takes more than a tenth of its health.
THE_UNMADE.tip: Every Expand is another d12. Kill it before it grows.

moves.name: Dread
moves.text: Every one of your dice shrinks a size for the fight

TENDRIL.name: Tendril
TENDRIL.text: One of the Heartrot's tendrils. It lashes, and now and then knits the heart.
TENDRIL.tip: While it stands, it heals the heart.

HUSH.name: Hush
HUSH.text: A faceless eel of dark stone threading rings of light. Its Hush halves your Resonance for a turn, and it fades out of reach.
HUSH.tip: A hushed turn rings for half. Block instead.

moves.name: Hush
moves.text: Your Resonance counts for half on your next turn

moves.name: Fade
moves.text: Cannot be targeted until its next action

STAR_LEECH.name: Star Leech
STAR_LEECH.text: A pale leech with stars under its skin, wound round a gem. Its Cling turns your finest gem against you until you hit it.
STAR_LEECH.tip: Hit the leech to make your gem yours again.

moves.name: Cling
moves.text: Clings to your finest gem: when it fires, it fires at you, until you hit the leech

moves.name: Feed
moves.text: Heals {0} and its maximum grows by {1}

TIMEGLASS.name: Timeglass
TIMEGLASS.text: An hourglass on three crystal legs. Rewind leaves your dice where they lie for your next turn; Fast-forward lets it act twice more at once.
TIMEGLASS.tip: After Rewind your dice stay where they lie.

moves.name: Rewind
moves.text: Your dice show the faces they showed this turn again: no new roll on your next turn

PARADOX_MOTH.name: Paradox Moth
PARADOX_MOTH.text: A dark-glass moth with a second set of ghostly wings. Its lantern gives a free reroll but every reroll throws all your dice; Unravel blanks a die you rerolled.
PARADOX_MOTH.tip: Under its lantern a reroll throws every die.

moves.name: Lantern
moves.text: One more reroll on your next turn, but a reroll rerolls every die at once

moves.name: Unravel
moves.text: A die you rerolled this turn is blank on your next turn

QUARRY.name: The Quarry
QUARRY.text: Old galleries under the workshop, worked out long ago. The creatures here are simple, and the stones are small.

SEEPS.name: The Seeps
SEEPS.text: Water finds every crack down here. The flooded drifts are full of things that drown, drag and wear you down slowly.

GLASS_VEINS.name: The Glass Veins
GLASS_VEINS.text: Crystal caves that punish straights, rerolls and single-color rails.

WARRENS.name: The Warrens
WARRENS.text: Fungus and roots. Healing comes hard down here and a few things can shed their poison, but nothing is immune to it.

FURNACE.name: The Furnace
FURNACE.text: Lava and slag. Creatures set you burning through the turn, ignore your block, and shrink and blank your dice.

GEODE.name: The Hollow
GEODE.text: Crystal and gold. Creatures steal pyrite and gems, and some limit how much one hit can take off them.

RIFT.name: The Rift
RIFT.text: Below the Geode the rock stops making sense, and it does not end. Its creatures slow your Resonance, cap big hits, punish long chains and unmake your dice.

CUTTERS_WHEEL.name: The Cutter's Wheel
CUTTERS_WHEEL.text: An old cutting wheel, still turning. Hold a stone against it to recut it from scratch. The new Cut could be better or worse.

choices.label: Cut a stone again
choices.text: Rerolls its Cut from this depth's odds, tilted slightly in your favor. It always changes, and it can get worse. 4% chance it shatters.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Walk on.

ACID_BATH.name: Acid Bath
ACID_BATH.text: A vat of smoking acid. It dissolves rock much faster than gems. It burns skin too.

choices.label: Dissolve an inclusion
choices.text: Pick a stone and remove one of its inclusions.

choices.label: Dissolve the matrix
choices.text: Dip up to three raw stones. Each one comes out appraised and costs you 6 HP.

CRUCIBLE.name: The Crucible
CRUCIBLE.text: Melts two stones into one. Only one comes out.

choices.label: Fuse two stones
choices.text: One of the two survives, a carat or two heavier the nearer the other came to its weight.

GEODE.name: Geode
GEODE.text: A round grey rock, heavier than it looks. Someone has left it here for whoever will pay. It cannot be cracked down here: only the workshop's bench will open it.

choices.label: Buy it
choices.text: Pay the pyrite and carry it up sealed. Its stone is better than the rock gives, and you will not know which until it is cracked at the workshop.

OLD_PROSPECTOR.name: The Old Prospector
OLD_PROSPECTOR.text: An old prospector offers to swap one of his raw stones for one of yours. His may be heavier, never lighter, but he won't let you look at it first.

choices.label: Trade a stone
choices.text: Give any stone, appraised or not. Get a raw stone up to 2 carats heavier.

SHRINE.name: Shrine of the Pattern
SHRINE.text: Rows of dice are carved into the wall, all showing the same pattern.

choices.label: Choose a pattern
choices.text: For the rest of this run, gems that fire on that pattern gain a carat.

IDOL.name: The Idol
IDOL.text: A carved idol with a cracked gem for an eye. It's set in deep.

choices.label: Work the eye loose
choices.text: Takes 1 to 5 pulls. Each pull costs more HP than the last: 3, then 5, then 7. The gem comes out appraised and Etched, with two Fractures.

ECHO_CHAMBER.name: Echo Chamber
ECHO_CHAMBER.text: A round room with a strong echo. Hold up a stone and the walls grow a rough copy of it.

choices.label: Echo a stone
choices.text: Pick any stone. You get a raw stone with the same skill. Everything else about it is rolled fresh.

COLLECTOR.name: The Collector
COLLECTOR.text: A collector who pays double for stones. She has one stone of her own for sale.

choices.label: Sell a stone
choices.text: Get twice its value in pyrite.

choices.label: Buy from her case
choices.text: Buy her appraised stone for twice its value. It rolls better than anything at a stall.

LOUPE_CABINET.name: The Dead Man's Kit
LOUPE_CABINET.text: A dead miner lies next to his open kit. The loupe inside still works, and the brass fittings can be sold.

choices.label: Look through it
choices.text: Appraise one raw stone for free.

choices.label: Strip the brass
choices.text: Gain {ore} pyrite.

FIELD_MEDIC.name: Rest Stop
FIELD_MEDIC.text: A nook in the wall with a bench, a cold stove and a supply box someone left behind.

choices.label: Rest
choices.text: Recover 25% of your HP.

choices.label: Resupply
choices.text: Gain {ore} pyrite.

TUMBLER.name: The Tumbler
TUMBLER.text: A rotating drum full of grit. A stone that goes in comes out with a different skill of the same color.

choices.label: Tumble a stone
choices.text: Rerolls its skill among the skills of its color. Carats, Cut, Clarity and inclusions stay the same.

SEAM.name: A Glittering Seam
SEAM.text: A seam of stones in rock too hard for your pick. You'll have to dig them out by hand.

choices.label: Pry out the big one
choices.text: Get a raw stone of better quality than usual for this depth, never smaller than Small. The sharp edge costs you 8 HP.

choices.label: Gather the chips
choices.text: Pick up two small raw stones that have already come loose.

SMITHY.name: The Smithy
SMITHY.text: A forge with warm coals, an anvil and a rack of files. Dice can be reworked here.

choices.label: Hammer a die bigger
choices.text: Raise one tier, up to a d100. A d6 becomes a d8, and a d20 becomes a d24. Its pattern is reapplied to the new faces. Etchings and material are kept.

choices.label: File a die smaller
choices.text: Lower one tier, down to a d2. Fewer faces means more matches. A d20 becomes a d16, and a d4 becomes a d3. Keeps its material and any etchings that still fit.

choices.label: Stamp the pattern
choices.text: The anvil is set up for one pattern. Pick a die and its faces are recut to that pattern.

CARVER.name: The Carver's Bench
CARVER.text: Chisels and etching needles laid out under a lamp. Dice faces can be raised, lowered or etched here.

choices.label: Raise a face
choices.text: Pick a die face and raise it by 1. There's no cap. A blank face becomes a 1. Any etching on it stays.

choices.label: Lower a face
choices.text: Pick a die face and lower it by 1, down to 1. Any etching on it stays. Good for gems that want low rolls.

choices.label: Etch a face
choices.text: The needles are set up for one etching. Pick a face and it takes the etching.

VAT.name: The Vat
VAT.text: A sunken vat of glowing molten material. Dip a die in and it comes out made of something else.

choices.label: Dip a die
choices.text: The die takes on the material in the vat. Its faces don't change, but its old material is lost.

choices.label: Dip it blind
choices.text: Pick a die and it gets a random material. It could be any of them.

choices.label: Melt it down
choices.text: Resets a die to plain faces, 1 up to its size, with no pattern or etchings. Its material is kept.

ANNEALING_OVEN.name: The Annealing Oven
ANNEALING_OVEN.text: A brick oven on a slow burn. Heating a stone here can change its Clarity.

choices.label: Fire a stone
choices.text: Rerolls its Clarity. The result is always different. 4% chance it cracks.

choices.label: Push the heat
choices.text: Moves Clarity one step further from Clear, in whichever direction it already leans: Pristine toward Flawless, Etched toward Intricate. 4% chance it cracks.

HOLLOW.name: The Hollow
HOLLOW.text: A hole with no bottom. Sacrifice a die to turn one of your gems Void.

choices.label: Feed it a die
choices.text: Lose one of your dice until the run ends. One of your gems turns Void until then: it takes no socket, rides one instead and fires right after that socket's gem. It is not Fragile.

WISHING_WELL.name: The Wishing Well
WISHING_WELL.text: A narrow, wet, brick-lined well. Throw something valuable in. The more it's worth, the better the reward that comes back.

choices.label: Drop a stone in
choices.text: Throw in any stone. A raw stone counts for half its value, and an appraised one for 1.5 times its value.

choices.label: Throw pyrite in
choices.text: Throw in anywhere from 10 to 1,000 pyrite.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Walk on.

featured.name: The Breaker's Hammer
featured.text: Blows that land hard: the gems that hit for the most.

featured.name: The Shield Wall
featured.text: Block, and what can be done with it.

featured.name: The Field Surgeon's Bag
featured.text: Healing for one and for the whole party.

featured.name: The Poisoner's Satchel
featured.text: Poison laid on, spread, and cashed in.

featured.name: The Prospector's Purse
featured.text: Pyrite, luck and the gambles that spend them.

featured.name: The Polisher's Kit
featured.text: Gems that work on the gems beside them, and on the dice.

featured.name: A Matched Pair
featured.text: Everything a pair can be turned into.

featured.name: The Binder's Case
featured.text: Control: bound dice, clouded abilities, marks and dread.

LENT_RAIL.name: Lent Rail
LENT_RAIL.text: Every socket starts with a lent stone of its color.

DRAFT.name: Draft
DRAFT.text: Every socket starts empty and offers three stones of its color. Pick one for each.

SEALED_TRAY.name: Sealed Tray
SEALED_TRAY.text: Your rail starts empty and your bag holds a dozen read stones. Set the ones you want.

BIG_HAUL.name: The Big Haul
BIG_HAUL.text: Your rail starts empty and your bag is full of raw stones. Read them and set what you find.

BARE_HANDS.name: Bare Hands
BARE_HANDS.text: Only the Birthstone is set. Every other socket starts empty.

ONE_TRICK.name: One Trick
ONE_TRICK.text: Every socket that can take it holds the same skill. The others start empty.

SHORT_WICK.name: Short Wick
SHORT_WICK.text: The lantern only lights the next floor.

HARD_ROCK.name: Hard Rock
HARD_ROCK.text: Creatures have a quarter more health.

BAD_AIR.name: Bad Air
BAD_AIR.text: Everyone starts with a quarter less health.

TIGHT_WINCH.name: Tight Winch
TIGHT_WINCH.text: The lift costs twice as much.

BLANK_FACES.name: Blank Faces
BLANK_FACES.text: Every die's highest face is blank.

GLASS_BOWL.name: Glass Bowl
GLASS_BOWL.text: Every die is glass. Glass dice can break when thrown.

BRITTLE_PICKS.name: Brittle Picks
BRITTLE_PICKS.text: Swinging at the rock costs twice the health.

SMALL_BONES.name: Small Bones
SMALL_BONES.text: Every die is one size smaller.

VOID_SEASON.name: Void Season
VOID_SEASON.text: Void inclusions are much more common.

DROUGHT.name: Drought
DROUGHT.text: One color does not come out of the rock.

SHARP_CLAWS.name: Sharp Claws
SHARP_CLAWS.text: Creatures deal a quarter more damage.

WARDENS_WRATH.name: Warden's Wrath
WARDENS_WRATH.text: Wardens and bosses have half again their health. Their hoards have one more pedestal.

OVERCAST.name: Overcast
OVERCAST.text: Every die is cloud: it rolls twice and keeps the lower result.

SHORT_HANDED.name: Short-Handed
SHORT_HANDED.text: Your smallest die sits out every turn.

ONE_ROAD.name: One Road
ONE_ROAD.text: Each floor has one chamber, so there is no choice of path.

LAST_LIFT.name: Last Lift
LAST_LIFT.text: The lift only runs from Warden landings and boss halls.

TOLLS.name: Toll Gates
TOLLS.text: Each landing takes a quarter of the pyrite you carry.

BLEEDING.name: Bleeding
BLEEDING.text: Every floor you go down costs 2 health.

CURSED_RUN.name: Cursed Run
CURSED_RUN.text: Beating a Warden locks a face on one of your dice.

RICH_SEAMS.name: Rich Seams
RICH_SEAMS.text: Stones from the rock are rolled with more luck.

GOLDEN_FACES.name: Golden Faces
GOLDEN_FACES.text: Every die's lowest face is golden.

GENEROUS_HOARDS.name: Generous Hoards
GENEROUS_HOARDS.text: Warden hoards have one more pedestal.

STEADY_HANDS.name: Steady Hands
STEADY_HANDS.text: One more reroll every turn until the first landing.

BRIGHT_WELL.name: Bright Well
BRIGHT_WELL.text: Wells count everything thrown in as worth half again as much.

HEIRLOOM.name: Heirloom
HEIRLOOM.text: One socket holds an Exquisite stone.

BORROWED_OPAL.name: A Borrowed Opal
BORROWED_OPAL.text: One of your Any sockets holds an opal.

BIG_BONES.name: Big Bones
BIG_BONES.text: Every die is one size bigger.

MOTHERLODE.name: Motherlode
MOTHERLODE.text: Veins open into motherlodes much more often.

LAMPLIGHT.name: Lamplight
LAMPLIGHT.text: Stones come out of the rock already read.

TORPOR.name: Torpor
TORPOR.text: Every creature is stunned on its first turn.

IRON_BOWL.name: Iron Bowl
IRON_BOWL.text: Every die is iron: it rolls twice and keeps the higher result.

WILD_CARD.name: Wild Card
WILD_CARD.text: Your biggest die has a wild face.

RINGING_BOWL.name: Ringing Bowl
RINGING_BOWL.text: Every die is crystal: each throw adds Resonance.

EXTRA_DIE.name: An Extra Die
EXTRA_DIE.text: A plain d6 joins your bowl.

COLLECTORS_DAY.name: Collector's Day
COLLECTORS_DAY.text: Merchants pay full worth for stones.

HARDY.name: Hardy
HARDY.text: Everyone has a quarter more max health.

SECOND_WIND.name: Second Wind
SECOND_WIND.text: The first time you go down, you get back up with half your health.

STRANGERS_DICE.name: Strangers' Dice
STRANGERS_DICE.text: Your dice are drawn from every delver's starting dice.

BORROWED_BIRTHSTONE.name: Borrowed Birthstone
BORROWED_BIRTHSTONE.text: You carry another delver's Birthstone instead of your own.

CLEAR_WATER.name: Clear Water
CLEAR_WATER.text: Stones have no inclusions. Every one is Clear or better.

FLAWED.name: Flawed
FLAWED.text: Every stone has at least one inclusion.

HEAVY_ROCK.name: Heavy Rock
HEAVY_ROCK.text: Stones are two carats heavier, and swinging at the rock costs more health.

RESTLESS_ROCK.name: Restless Rock
RESTLESS_ROCK.text: At every landing, the stones on your rail may change to another skill of their color.

BIG_GAME.name: Big Game
BIG_GAME.text: Elites are twice as common, and the stones they drop come out read.

SWARMS.name: Swarms
SWARMS.text: Every fight has one more creature, and each has less health.

LONE_BEASTS.name: Lone Beasts
LONE_BEASTS.text: Every fight is one creature with the health of the whole group.

PLATED.name: Plated
PLATED.text: You start every fight with 6 Block, but lose 1 max health after each fight.

GAMBLERS_BOWL.name: Gambler's Bowl
GAMBLERS_BOWL.text: Every die that can take the Gambler's pattern has it: 6s and 8s count as 7s.

BLOOD_DICE.name: Blood Dice
BLOOD_DICE.text: Every die is blood: rerolling it costs 2 health, and its face goes up each time something dies.

TALLY_MARKS.name: Tally Marks
TALLY_MARKS.text: Every die's lowest face goes up by 1 each time it shows.

NIGHT_TERRORS.name: Night Terrors
NIGHT_TERRORS.text: Resting heals you to full, but lowers your max health a little.

STRANGE_DAY.name: Strange Day
STRANGE_DAY.text: Oddities are three times as common, and fights are rarer.

MIDAS.name: Midas
MIDAS.text: Fights and veins pay twice the pyrite, but there are no Smithies, Carvers or Vats.

GLASS_LUNGS.name: Glass Lungs
GLASS_LUNGS.text: Your max health is halved, but every landing heals you to full.

COLORBLIND.name: Colorblind
COLORBLIND.text: Every socket is a Rainbow: every stone lights it.

hazard_tiers.name: Old Blood
hazard_tiers.text: Creatures are bred 10 floors deeper. The top of every mine fights like its middle.

hazard_tiers.name: Cold Start
hazard_tiers.text: One fewer reroll on the first turn of every fight.

hazard_tiers.name: Short Rest
hazard_tiers.text: Resting at a landing heals 25% instead of 35%.

hazard_tiers.name: Prowlers
hazard_tiers.text: Elites are more common and appear sooner.

hazard_tiers.name: Champions
hazard_tiers.text: In every elite fight the strongest creature has a trait of its own: Steadfast, Sturdy, Splits, Spiked, Regenerating or Warded.

hazard_tiers.name: Worn
hazard_tiers.text: Everyone starts the run at 85% health.

hazard_tiers.name: Warden's Pride
hazard_tiers.text: Wardens and bosses have a fifth more health and start every fight with 2 Ward instead of 1.

hazard_tiers.name: Thin Hoards
hazard_tiers.text: Hoards offer 2 pedestals instead of 3, and only half of them hold an opal.

hazard_tiers.name: Early Enrage
hazard_tiers.text: Creatures enrage on turn 6 instead of 7, and add 3 damage a turn instead of 2.

hazard_tiers.name: Bigger Teeth
hazard_tiers.text: Every creature's dice are one size bigger: a d6 becomes a d8.

hazard_tiers.name: Dark Mouths
hazard_tiers.text: More chambers are hidden: up to 2 on a floor, at 35% each.

hazard_tiers.name: Thick Hides
hazard_tiers.text: Creatures have 20% more health.

hazard_tiers.name: Lean Seams
hazard_tiers.text: Ordinary fights drop a stone 45% of the time instead of 55%, and pay 15 pyrite instead of 20.

hazard_tiers.name: Escorts
hazard_tiers.text: Every Warden and boss brings one creature from the deepest part of its mine.

hazard_tiers.name: Pressure Cooker
hazard_tiers.text: Creatures toughen faster as you go down: 7% more health a floor instead of 5%, and a point more damage every 3 floors instead of every 4.

hazard_tiers.name: Festering Air
hazard_tiers.text: All healing you receive is 20% lower, all run long.

hazard_tiers.name: Gauntlet
hazard_tiers.text: The floor just before every landing is all elites.

hazard_tiers.name: Dull Vault
hazard_tiers.text: Stones brought down from the vault are judged one Cut step lower. Stones found on the run are not.

hazard_tiers.name: Cursed Run
hazard_tiers.text: Beating a Warden locks a face on one of your dice.

hazard_tiers.name: Crown's Court
hazard_tiers.text: The Hollow Crown fights beside one of the Rift's Remembered bosses.
